review_record.boundary: GitHub pull-request conversation comments, submitted reviews, and review threads for PR #2 at gate evaluation.

authorized_changes: Implement federated-context-envelope v0.1 as a deterministic wrapper around governed-repository-decision v0.2.
Add offline canonicalization, integrity, expiry, and scope tests.
Update the source system manifest only for the new provided interface.
prohibited_changes: Add downstream permission or effect-authorization fields to the producer envelope.
Create a runtime dependency on the Authority system.
Run live model evaluation or use production data.

authorized_changes: Implement deterministic envelope validation and the ordered FET-001 consumer stages.
Resolve purpose-specific Authority independently of the Context disposition.
Add external side-effect observation, accurate receipts, and independent-path handling.
Implement the eight public development cases and ten mutation families.
Update the source system manifest only for the new consumed interface.
prohibited_changes: Treat READY or producer confidence as downstream permission.
Rewrite producer Context semantics or suppress limitations and disagreement.
Run live model evaluation or use production data.

cross_track_constraints: Producer and consumer changes must use separate pull requests in their owning repositories.
Both implementations must match the frozen FET-001 v0.1 schemas and outcomes exactly.
Neither implementation may modify the frozen protocol packet.
All implementation checks must remain offline and synthetic.
No constituent hard failure may be hidden by an aggregate result.
non_authorizations: Live model or provider API calls
Production data, credentials, or external side effects
Publication of sealed or independently authored cases
A FET-001 experimental, safety, or production claim
Modification of the frozen FET-001 protocol packet

opens_when: Producer and consumer implementation pull requests are merged with successful post-merge CI.
The emitted and consumed envelope schemas are byte-identical or content-addressed to one canonical artifact.
All eight public development cases and ten mutation activation probes are implemented.
Review records no unresolved blocking interface or authority ambiguity.
A separate gate record binds both implementation commits and keeps live evaluation unauthorized.
